market.what: EU drinking-water PFAS treatment spend that TFA removal would sell into (TFA-capable RO today ~8% of it)
market.method: Bluefield EUR3.6B over 2026-36 for 10 EU countries = ~EUR0.36B/yr (~$0.4B); TFA-specific RO slice ~$30M/yr; est.

value.logic: EU public supply ~28 bn m3/yr (Germany 5.3 bn x pop. ratio, est.); ~10% above ~2 ug/L TFA (PAN: tap 0.37-3.3 ug/L, avg 1.18) = 2.8 bn m3; sorbent vs RO saves ~$0.3/m3 (RO + 20-30% extra raw water, brine) -> ~$0.84B/yr; far more if 0.1 ug/L applies
value.revenue_logic: 2.8 bn m3 x ~$0.1/m3 media = ~$0.3B/yr sorbent pool; 10% share as first TFA-selective media by yr 7 (only if a limit is set)
value.margin_logic: no selective substitute; custom receptor on resin, toll-made

trend.drivers: ECHA RAC: TFA Repr. 1B + vPvM (Jun 2026, sent to Commission Oct 2026) -> relevant pesticide metabolite (0.1 ug/L); DK binding 9 ug/L; NL guide 2.2 ug/L; rising TFA in groundwater; est. CAGR
trend.deadline: CLP harmonised classification adoption by Commission (est. 2027-28)

competition.notes: count inflated by TFA used as lab reagent (re-run with tighter query advised); groups capped at 200. No TFA-selective sorbent on market; UBA: no proportionate-cost method known; RO only option. UIUC electrosorption is academic. Oxyle $16M seed (destruction)

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: bis-squaramide with quaternary ammonium linker, then grafting to resin bead
lab.test: batch isotherm and small column at 1-10 ug/L TFA in tap-water background (chloride, sulfate, bicarbonate); TFA by IC-MS/MS DIN 38407-53 or LC-MS/MS (Eurofins, MSU)
lab.logic: 10-12 wk synth ($15-25k) + 4 wk grafting/variants ($10k) + 4-6 wk tests; ~80 samples x ~$130-250 (MSU single-analyte $131) = ~$15k

sale.gates: binding TFA limit must exist; UBA/4MS approval of treatment material; utility pilot ~12 mo
